Anthem, Inc. (NYSE:ANTM) entered into an agreement to acquire Missouri and Nebraska Medicaid plans from WellCare Health Plans, Inc. (NYSE:WCG).. Anthem, Inc. (NYSE:ANTM) entered into an agreement to acquire Missouri and Nebraska Medicaid plans from WellCare Health Plans, Inc. (NYSE:WCG) on September 26, 2019. WellCare Health Plans, Inc. employees, who operate and manage these plans will, become part of Anthem, Inc. The transaction is subject to U.S. federal antitrust clearance, receipt of Missouri and Nebraska state regulatory approvals and other customary closing conditions, as well as the closing of the Centene Corporation and WellCare Health Plans, Inc. transaction. Evercore acted as financial advisor and Skadden, Arps, Slate, Meagher & Flom LLP acted as legal advisor for Centene Corporation, in connection with the sale. Kirkland & Ellis LLP, Locke Lord LLP, and Bass Berry & Sims PLC acted as legal advisors for WellCare Health Plans, Inc.

Anthem, Inc. Elects Ryan Schneider to Serve as an Independent Director and Member Audit Committee of the Board Effective Immediately. Anthem, Inc. announced that on October 1, 2019, the Board of Directors of the company elected Ryan Schneider to serve as an independent director effective immediately, with a term expiring at the company's 2022 annual meeting of shareholders. The Board also appointed Mr. Schneider to the Audit Committee of the Board. Mr. Schneider, 49, is the Chief Executive Officer for Realogy Holdings Corporation.

Anthem's Board Names Ryan Schneider as New Director. Anthem reported that Ryan Schneider has joined the Board. Schneider is the Chief Executive Officer for Realogy Holdings Corp., a provider of residential real estate franchising and brokerage. Prior to joining Realogy, he served as President for Capital One's Card division, where he was responsible for U.S., U.K., and Canada credit card businesses. He also previously served as a partner at McKinsey and Company focused on its financial services clients.
